scenes.stage_direction: Rain, interrupted sleep and a missing infant. Preserve the distinction between Amara's true sighting and the unexplained means of entry.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: David. Come to the house. Ethan is gone.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: I am coming. Are you somewhere safe?

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: I saw Victor carrying him. I called his name and the lights went out.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Tell me which door you are standing beside.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: The back door. It is still bolted. The gate is locked. I don't understand how he left.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Stay there. Don't go into the rain looking by yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Bring him back. Please, David. Save the baby. Whatever happens, make sure he comes back alive.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: I am at the gate. Let me in, Amara.

choices.label: Call Detective Morris
choices.speaker: David
choices.impact: Request police assistance and preserve the scene while the search begins.
choices.response: I am calling Morris. He needs to hear what you saw from you, Amara. I will stay beside you.

choices.label: Trace the message with Amara
choices.speaker: David
choices.impact: Begin with the original message and Amara's knowledge of the household. No technical result is certain.
choices.response: Keep the original message open. I will examine the record; you tell me what the names and places mean.

choices.label: Follow the rear passage yourself
choices.speaker: David
choices.impact: Begin with direct observation without nearby police backup. Amara receives David's location.
choices.response: I will check the passage first. Here is my location. If I need help, I am going to ask for it—not disappear too.

metadata.notes: Opening suspense scene and choice for the first playable investigation.
metadata.canon: Ethan is Amara's child; David is her partner, not his biological father.
